title: CurvTrust-PAI: Reference-anchored neighbourhood-overlap residual for network intrusion analysis and trust-based safety filtering in multi-agent cyber-physical systems
description: CurvTrust-PAI evaluates a reference-anchored neighbourhood-overlap residual (absolute deviation of a Jaccard neighbourhood-overlap score from its median over a clean reference set) in two independent settings: (1) network-flow intrusion analysis, where the residual is used as an auxiliary classifier feature and as a stand-alone conformal detector; and (2) trust-conditioned safety filtering in a simulated multi-agent swarm, where the residual is combined with identity, kinematic innovation and graph-isolation evidence to set the separation margin of a relative-degree-two barrier filter. The repository contains the experimental pipeline (digital intrusion detection + swarm trust/HOCBF filter), extracted tables and figures from the manuscript, and aggregated results JSON. Datasets are third-party and not redistributed.
